tokens.npc_dota_hero_mars_bio:
Mars, first son of heaven, spent a long existence waging endless war, and saw countless more crusades waged beneath the banner of his old name. Wars of conquest and of vengeance. Just and unjust... Always cruel. So much like his father, Mars indulged his basest impulses--with inclinations much more monstrous than those of Zeus--and he inflicted suffering untold.

But as the epochs vanished behind him, the selfish ways of his father--the ways of many amongst his godly kin, they who judged him despicable--eventually began to ring hollow. War for its own sake was no longer enough to satisfy his desires. For the first time in his ageless days, the god of war began to question to what ends he swung his glorious spear.

As the Fates would have it, his solution came easily: he must wage war for a larger purpose, and inspire more than mere savagery and sorrow at the sight of his crest. He must at last lay claim to the mantle of leadership that is his birthright, for the time has come to burn down the pantheon of the old age and build a just new empire atop the ashes of his kin. Only then might he find satisfaction, and make the glory of Mars evident to all.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_mars_hype: The warrior deity Mars thrives in the heart of strife, guarded by the bulk of a deadly shield as he skewers enemies with his legendary spear. He revels in facing opponents in an arena ringed with loyal spearmen—who guarantee that no one escapes and that whatever odds he's facing, the god of war can dictate the terms of battle knowing the crowd is forever on his side.

* The ability has two main components:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|21px|1]] {{Symbol|Affect|Self}} {{Symbol|bonus ampin-p}}
*** {{Symbol|Facing Angle|r}} {{hi|Mars}} [[File:Dota2 Mars Bulwark Segment icon.png|84px|The ability's angles visualized.]]
**** The ability compares the incoming damage source's current position and Mars' {{M|facing angle}} per damage instance.
**** With {{hi|Mars}} [[File:Dota2 Letter-o.png|21px|O]] as the centerpoint, its front as the x-axis, covering a [[Wikipedia:Circular segment|circular segment]] with an infinite area [[File:Dota2 Mars Bulwark Front icon.png|21px|Front]] in front of Mars.
**** [[File:Dota2 Mars Bulwark Segment Rear icon.png|84px]] [[File:Dota2 Mars Bulwark Front icon.png|21px|Front]] The front has the following properties:
***** {{Code|OP}} and {{Code|OQ}} are two [[Wikipedia:Line (geometry)#Ray|rays]] that defines the front area, both point [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|21px|P]] and point [[File:Dota2 Letter-q.png|21px|Q]] are positioned {{Code|{{#expr:{{#explode:{{#var:Bulwark value1}}|°}}/2}}°}} clockwise and counterclockwise from point [[File:Dota2 Letter-o.png|21px|O]] respectively.
****** {{Code|[[Wikipedia:Angle|∠]] POQ {{=}} {{#var:Bulwark value1}}}}
**** [[File:Dota2 Mars Bulwark Segment Side icon.png|84px]] [[File:Dota2 Mars Bulwark Side icon.png|21px|Side]] The sides have the following properties:
***** The damage reduction component does not stack with the rear area.
***** Hence, [[File:Dota2 Mars Bulwark Side icon.png|21px|Side]] the side's effective [[area-of-effect]] is {{Code|{{#expr:({{#explode:{{#var:Bulwark value2}}|°}}-{{#explode:{{#var:Bulwark value1}}|°}})/2}}°}} circular segment away from both {{Code|OP}} and {{Code|OQ}}.
**** Grants Mars the following bonuses within the [[damage reduction]] angle:
***** Applies a generic [[incoming damage]] reduction on Mars with the following properties:
****** Stacks additively with other generic incoming damage manipulation source.
****** Does not affect {{M|HP Removal}} sources.
****** This ability component is applied before {{M|damage block}} calculations and [[after reductions]].
****** {{Symbol|fx|v}}
******* Despite using the same mechanic visuals and animations, both Bulwark and the damage block mechanic are independent of each other.
***** Has the following additional properties:
****** Procs on certain {{M|spell damage}} [[Damage Block#Blocked Spell Damage|sources]] that reacts on {{M|damage block}}.
****** Procs on the {{Symbol|bonus agh}} {{A|Bounty Hunter|Jinada}} application on {{A|Bounty Hunter|Shuriken Toss}}.
****** Certain {{M|instant attack}} sources do not interact with this component.
****** Affects attack damage sources of the following units:
******* {{M|Buildings}}
******* {{M|Ward-type units}}, except {{U|Death Ward}}.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|21px|2]] {{Symbol|Toggle|On}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*** Applies {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|mars_bulwark_active}} with following ability effects on Mars when [[toggled]] on:
**** {{M|Disarm}}
**** {{M|Phase movement}} with a {{M|movement speed}} slow.
**** {{Symbol|Turn Rate}}
***** A [[turn rate]] factor, effectively locking Mars' {{M|facing angle}} and is defined as:
***** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|Current[[Turn Rate|TurnRate]] {{=}} {{Show|H|Mars|turnrate}} × {{#var:Bulwark type1 value5}}}}
***** All Mars' ability casts, including {{M|item}} abilities, within its respective {{M|cast range}} limits, neither requires [[turning]] nor [[facing]] the targeted location or unit to cast, as long it is within the cast range.
**** The offensive incoming {{M|ranged}} {{M|attack damage}}-based {{M|projectile}} redirection component.

** The redirection proc chance is determined upon the attack damage-based projectile launch, and is immediately launched toward Mars instead of the intended attack target upon proc, with the following properties:
*** [[File:Dota2 Mars Bulwark Front icon.png|21px|Front]]
**** The attacking unit has to be in front of Mars.
**** The affected allied unit has to be within {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#var:Bulwark type1 value2}}-distance around Mars, or within [[File:Dota2 Mars Bulwark Side icon.png|21px|Side]] {{#var:Bulwark type1 value3}}-distance behind Mars.
**** Considers the following projectile types:
***** Regular attack damage-based projectiles.
***** {{M|Instant attack}}-based projectiles, this includes instant attacks sourced to {{M|ranged}} units without projectiles.
***** {{M|Ward-type units}}.
*** Redirect projectiles when Mars is affected by the following sources:
**** Within the {{M|Fog of War}}.
**** {{M|Invisible}} sources.
** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*** Does not redirect projectiles when Mars is affected by the following sources:
**** {{M|Attack immune}} sources.
**** {{M|Hidden}} sources.
**** {{M|Invulnerable}} sources.
*** Does not automatically toggle {{Symbol|Toggle|Off}} when affected by the following sources:
**** {{M|Disable}} sources.
**** {{M|Hidden|x}} sources.
**** {{M|Silence}} sources.

Can be toggled, granting phased movement, removing Mars's ability to attack, and locking the direction he is facing. When active, reduces movement speed and re-directs 70% of the attack projectiles aimed at allies towards himself. }} * Increases Mars' effective health to the following values: ** [[File:Dota2 Mars Bulwark Front icon.png|21px|Front]] {{cf|expr}} {{Code|Front EHP {{=}} Current[[Health|HP]] × {{calc|1+(v1/(1-v1)) round2|v1={{#var:Bulwark value3}}}}}} ** [[File:Dota2 Mars Bulwark Side icon.png|21px|Side]] {{cf|expr}} {{Code|Side EHP {{=}} Current[[Health|HP]] × {{calc|1+(v1/(1-v1)) round2|v1={{#var:Bulwark value4}}}}}} * The ability animations and sound effects has the following properties upon an {{M|incoming damage}} reduction proc: ** Considers attacks from {{M|clones}}, {{M|illusions}} and the {{H|Spirit Bear}} as heroes, other {{M|creep-heroes}} as creeps. ** [[File:Dota2 Mars Bulwark Front icon.png|21px|Front]] *** For heroes: Plays a larger attack-block animation with Mars Bulwark 1.mp3 sound effect. *** For creeps: Plays a smaller attack-block animation with Mars Bulwark 2.mp3 sound effect. ** [[File:Dota2 Mars Bulwark Side icon.png|21px|Side]] *** For heroes: Plays a smaller attack-block animation with Mars Bulwark 2.mp3 sound effect. *** For creeps: Nothing. * {{A|Mars|Spear of Mars}} checks if Bulwark is toggled {{cf|On}} upon cast, and automatically toggles Bulwark {{cf|Off}} before its {{M|cast point}}. ** If Spear of Mars is not successfully cast, Bulwark automatically toggles {{cf|On}} again. ** This indirectly causes Mars to {{M|Turn Rate|text=turn}} toward the point-targeted location despite Bulwark being toggled {{cf|On}}. * For {{U|Death Ward}}: ** Bulward redirects its attack {{M|projectile}}, but does not apply the {{M|incoming damage|t=p}} reduction. ** Does not redirect {{Symbol|bonus agh}} {{U|Death Ward}} projectiles, since it is now {{M|spell damage}}-based upon acquiring its {{M|Aghanim's Scepter|text=ability upgrade}}.

* The ability effects are applied as follows:
*# The checks for valid enemy heroes per {{M|server tick}} within the radius.
*# Grants a bonus {{M|health regeneration}} amplification stack per outnumbered enemy heroes within the radius, while including allied heroes, and is defined as:

* Considers enemy {{M|clones}} and {{M|creep-heroes}} as heroes, {{M|illusions}} as creeps.

data.bio_loc:
Mars, first son of heaven, spent a long existence waging endless war, and saw countless more crusades waged beneath the banner of his old name. Wars of conquest and of vengeance. Just and unjust... Always cruel. So much like his father, Mars indulged his basest impulses--with inclinations much more monstrous than those of Zeus--and he inflicted suffering untold.

But as the epochs vanished behind him, the selfish ways of his father--the ways of many amongst his godly kin, they who judged him despicable--eventually began to ring hollow. War for its own sake was no longer enough to satisfy his desires. For the first time in his ageless days, the god of war began to question to what ends he swung his glorious spear.

As the Fates would have it, his solution came easily: he must wage war for a larger purpose, and inspire more than mere savagery and sorrow at the sight of his crest. He must at last lay claim to the mantle of leadership that is his birthright, for the time has come to burn down the pantheon of the old age and build a just new empire atop the ashes of his kin. Only then might he find satisfaction, and make the glory of Mars evident to all.
data.hype_loc: The warrior deity Mars thrives in the heart of strife, guarded by the bulk of a deadly shield as he skewers enemies with his legendary spear. He revels in facing opponents in an arena ringed with loyal spearmen—who guarantee that no one escapes and that whatever odds he's facing, the god of war can dictate the terms of battle knowing the crowd is forever on his side.
data.npe_desc_loc: Traps his foes in an inescapable arena

abilities.name: mars_spear
abilities.desc_loc: Mars throws his legendary Spear with deadly precision, damaging each enemy unit it strikes. The first enemy hero it hits is skewered on the spear, pushing it back. If a skewered hero hits a tree, building, or cliff, they will be impaled to it and stunned.
abilities.lore_loc: The legendary Spear of Mars still glows with the heat of the forge god's fires.
notes_loc: Spear of Mars can hit invisible units and reveals them if they are stunned.
Spear of Mars will only pin a unit to cliffs onto elevated areas, otherwise it will push them off onto lower ground.
abilities.shard_loc: Spear of Mars impales up to %max_impale_targets% heroes and leaves a fire trail behind that deals damage over time and slows movement speed.

abilities.name: mars_gods_rebuke
abilities.desc_loc: Mars smashes enemies in front of him with his shield, knocking them back and damaging them with a critical hit based on his attack. Bonus damage is added when hitting heroes. Has True Strike.
abilities.lore_loc: There isn't a warrior alive who can stand unmoved by the sting of Mars' rebuke.
notes_loc: Attack modifiers have a chance to proc on God's Rebuke attacks.

abilities.name: mars_bulwark
abilities.desc_loc:
Mars wields his massive shield to block a portion of each physical attack when hit from the front or sides.

Can be toggled, granting phased movement, removing Mars's ability to attack, and locking the direction he is facing. When active, reduces movement speed and re-directs %redirect_chance%%% of the attack projectiles aimed at allies towards himself.
abilities.lore_loc: Only the very foolish dare to fight fair with the god of war.
notes_loc: Redirect only works if the projectile targets are in a cone behind Mars or within 100 range of him.
Break disables the front and side damage reduction.
abilities.scepter_loc: Creates %soldier_count% invulnerable soldiers on both sides of Mars front while Bulwark is toggled on. Soldiers move alongside Mars, dealing his attacks that have bonus damage, knock back and slow approaching enemies. An enemy can only be attacked by one soldier at a time.

abilities.name: mars_dauntless
abilities.desc_loc: Mars gets more HP Regen the more he is outnumbered by enemy heroes in %radius% radius.

abilities.name: mars_arena_of_blood
abilities.desc_loc: After a short formation time, Mars summons an arena lined with the undead warriors of the Ash Legion, who block enemy attacks and movement. Enemy heroes near the inside edge of the arena will be attacked by spears, dealing damage and knocking them back.
abilities.lore_loc: The long-dead members of the Ash Legion, assembled from the finest warriors to ever test the might of Mars, still revel in the thrill of combat, gladly beholden to the hand that fell them for as long as he so commands.
abilities.scepter_loc: Lowers cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s and increases duration. If an enemy is killed in the Arena, Mars and all of his allies inside the Arena restore %arena_kill_buff_heal_pct%%  of their max health and mana and get a %arena_kill_buff_damage_pct%%  attack damage buff for %arena_kill_buff_duration%s. This effect stacks.
facets_loc: If Mars is in the Arena when an enemy dies inside of it, he restores %arena_kill_buff_heal_pct%%% of his max health and mana and gets a %arena_kill_buff_damage_pct%%% attack damage buff for %arena_kill_buff_duration%s. Allies inside the Arena receive %allied_reduction_pct%%% of the bonuses.
Arena of Blood obscures vision and enemies within the arena do not share vision with their allies.

talents.name_loc: Arena Of Blood Grants Team +{s:bonus_health_regen} HP Regen
